scope.interactionChannel: real macOS secondary mouse click and keyboard menu selection via cliclick

snapshot.source: isolated copy of the Electron showcase environment

observations.name: expanded system menu content
observations.detail: A physical secondary click opens the macOS system menu with New thread on main, Settle thread, Rename thread, Copy path, Copy branch, Mark unread, Archive, and destructive Delete.

observations.name: new thread on branch selection
observations.detail: Keyboard selection from the physical system menu opens the New thread hero for background-only and preserves Current checkout on main.

observations.name: mark unread selection outcome
observations.detail: The isolated thread has latest_turn_id and completed_at set to null, so the shared Mark unread mutation correctly has no timestamp to project. Menu presence is verified; mutation outcome is not.

classification.closedProductLoss: The Native menu exposes Mark unread and New thread on main, and branch-preserving draft creation is physically verified.
remainingProductLoss: Capability-gated Snooze or Wake and Regenerate title remain absent.
missingCoverage: Mark unread mutation needs a fixture with a non-null latest turn completion.
Dark theme and settled-thread variants are not retained in this slice.
classification.harnessLoss: Desktop DevTool registration remains unavailable, so window-server frames and isolated persisted state are used without DevTool console or LynxView geometry credit.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: The macOS menu uses native platform material and metrics.
